To read more baking tips,. read "How to Bake BREAD with SUCCESS".
To Print this recipe, see below.

name: Ube Hopia
instructions: ​Gather all sides and seal.
Place the dough into a round cookie cutter.
Press to shape by using your fingers or palm of your hand.
Remove from the cookie cutter and transfer to a tray lined with parchment paper.
Brush with egg wash.
Bake at 400 F for about 15-20 minutes or until top is golden.
Remove from oven.
Serve warm.
Enjoy.

name: Ube Roll
instructions: Make sure eggs are at room temperature. Take them out in the fridge 30 minutes before using. Room temperature eggs whip up to a greater volume. But take note that it’s easiest to separate whites from yolks cleanly when they are cold, this should be done when starting the recipe. Then let stand at room temperature while preparing the other ingredients.

It is critical that the meringue for the frosting has totally cooled down before adding the butter. Hold the bottom of the mixing bowl to check it is cold enough. If not, you can rest it and when ready, re-whip before adding the butter. If butter is added too soon, it will melt and your frosting will become runny and will be hard to come together. You'll end up wasting your frosting ingredients.
If cake flour is not available, please see my recipe above how it can be substituted and make sure to follow the process.

​If you are not really good at spreading the frosting, you can hide the flaws by using cake crumbs to cover them. To get some extra crumbs, cut the edges of the rolled cake (without frosting) and pulse in food processor or manually crumble them.

Cream of tartar is essential on this recipe. Do not omit because it helps stabilize the egg whites when making meringue. Lemon juice or white vinegar can be used as a substitute if cream of tartar is not available.

name: Ube Macapuno Cake
instructions: Beat the egg whites until frothy.
Add the salt and 1 tbsp sugar.
Beat at  medium speed until soft peak. Set aside.
In a sauce pan, combine water and sugar. Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Bring to a boil over moderate heat (no need to stir).
Boil for 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and slowly pour hot syrup into whites, beating constantly until meringue is cool to the touch.
***NOTE*** Before proceeding, make sure meringue has cooled down.
Add softened butter (1 tbsp at a time), beating well after each addition until mixture is smooth.
***Mixture may look curdled before all of the butter is added but will come back together by the time beating is finished.

name: ​Ube Mamon
instructions: ​Pour-in the liquid ingredients to the flour mixture. Continue mixing until light & fluffy.
Using a spatula, gently fold in the egg whites mixture into the batter mixture.
Pour the batter evenly into the prepared molds.
Bake for 15-20 minutes. Do not over bake. (Oven temperature varies, please check before the set time).
Cake is ready if toothpick inserted comes out clean.​
Note: A slight deflation is normal once the cake cools down.
Top with grated cheese (if desired).

name: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: If you ask me personally which method I prefer, for me it doesn't matter. Either way is achieves a great chocolate cookies. If you have time, it doesn't hurt to refrigerate or freeze them.
I notice that about 8 minutes is already enough to make the first batch which is the one that was baked right after mixing. The refrigerated one needs more time in the oven which is about 10 minutes.
Parchment paper is a good choice for easy cleaning of the cookie sheet, but having a cookie silicone baking mat is just perfect. I highly suggest to get one.
For the baking chocolate bar, you can omit and replace with chocolate chips. I highly recomment to get the baking chocolate bar with 50% cacao or higher.

name: Uraro (Arrowroot) Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, softened at room temperature
ingredientNames: 1/2 cup butter, softened at room temperature
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 F.
In a medium bowl, sift arrowroot flour, all-purpose flour and baking powder. Whisk to combine. Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, cream the butter on high speed.
Add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Add egg and maple extract. Beat until well combined.
Gradually add flour mixture. Beat on low speed until all flour is added. Then beat on high speed until the mixture has come together.
Using a Cookie Press, press cookie dough onto ungreased baking pan. If cookie press is not available, roll the dough into balls (no more than an inch) then flatten with a fork.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the sides start to turn golden.  (Make sure to check before the set times as oven temperature varies. Baking time affects the type of baking sheet being used.)
Remove from oven and leave on the pan for about 5 minutes then transfer wire rack  to cool completely.
Store in airtight container.
Enjoy.

name: Vanilla Cupcakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Prepare the lightly greased muffin pan or lined with paper cups.
Mix together flour, baking powder and salt. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, beat the butter until smooth.
Add the sugar and beat until light and fluffy (3-5 minutes).
Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Beat in the vanilla extract.
Add the flour mixture (in three additions) and milk (in two additions), beginning and ending with the flour. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed.
Fill the muffin cups with the batter.
Bake for about 18 -20 minutes or just until set and a toothpick inserted into the center of a cupcake comes out clean.
(Always check a few minutes before the stated baking time. ﻿Do not overbake or the cupcakes will be dry﻿.)
Cool on wire rack. Enjoy your cupcakes.
If you have tried this recipe, please drop down a comment below. ​

name: Vanilla Cupcakes with Whipped Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened at room temperature
ingredientNames: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened at room temperature
instructions: Do not overbeat the cake batter. Beat until just combined.
Always check a few minutes before the stated baking time. ﻿Do not overbake or the cupcakes will be dry.
Powdered sugar for the frosting can be adjusted according to your sweetness preference. I do not like overly sweet frosting so I only added 2 tbsp. ​​
Printable recipe below.
If you have tried this recipe or have inquiry, please drop down a comment below. ​

name: Yema Cake - No-Bake
instructions: In a sauce pan, combine evaporated milk, condensed milk, egg yolks and vanilla.
Simmer over low heat while stirring constantly until mixture becomes slightly thick.
Remove from heat. Set aside.

name: Yema Chiffon Cake - Baked
instructions: ​​In a saucepan,  combine all the yema ingredients (except butter). Whisk until well combined. Cook over low heat while stirring constantly until thick. Turn off heat then add butter and continue stirring until butter is fully melted. Let cool.

Peel off the parchment paper from the cake and trim the sides. Spread yema on top of the first layer then add the 2nd layer then top with yema. You can cover the whole cake as well. Top with grated cheese. I used Queso brand.
Serve and enjoy!

name: White Bread​
instructions: Form the dough into a ball and transfer the dough to a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp cloth or plastic food wrap and let it rise in a warm place for at least an hour.
After rising, gently press to release some air packets and transfer onto a lightly floured surface. ​​

Gently pat it into a 9x12-inch rectangle. Roll up the rectangle, starting on the short end and shape into a fat 9-inch log. Pinch to seal the seams and the ends, tuck the ends of the roll and place into greased 9-inch loaf pan.
Cover with damp cloth or plastic food wrap and let it rise again in a warm place for 30-45 minutes or until it's crowned 1" to 1 1/2" over the rim of the pan.
Position an oven rack on the lowest setting and preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.
Brush the loaves with some of the melted butter.
Bake the loaves for 35 to 40 minutes, rotating halfway through, until golden brown (an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 195-200 degrees F).
Remove from the oven and immediately brush with more of the melted butter. Allow to cool for 10 minutes, then remove from the pans and cool completely before slicing.

name: Baked Macaroni & Cheese
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees F. Grease baking dish with cooking spray.
Cook pasta according to package direction; drain & set aside.
In medium sauce pan, over medium heat, melt 3 tbsp butter.
Whisk in flour and salt.
Gradually whisk in milk.
Cook and stir until mixture thickens and begins to bubble.
Add velveeta cheese; stir until melted. Remove from heat.
Add the cooked macaroni and transfer to a buttered or greased baking dish.
In  small bowl, combine 1 tsp melted butter, bread crumbs and parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle over top of macaroni.
Bake for 20 minutes or until crumb mixture is golden brown and edges are bubbly.
Let stand for 10 minutes  before serving.
Enjoy! ​

name: Baked Pasta
ingredients: 1 package pasta of your choice   ( I used egg wide noodles)
1 can (26 oz) spaghetti sauce     (I used hunts four cheese)
1 bottle, 19 oz tamis anghang banana sauce (catsup)
roasted chicken ( shredded) or any meat of your choice like ground beef or pork.
ingredientNames: 1 package pasta of your choice   ( I used egg wide noodles)
1 can (26 oz) spaghetti sauce     (I used hunts four cheese)
1 bottle, 19 oz tamis anghang banana sauce (catsup)
roasted chicken ( shredded) or any meat of your choice like ground beef or pork.
instructions: Prepare the noodles according to package directions.
Heat oil in a pan and saute' garlic and onion.
Add the meat of your choice.
Add the spaghetti sauce, banana sauce, and sugar.
Cook on medium heat while stirring occasionally for 15 minutes or until the sauce gets thick.
Season with parsley flakes, salt & pepper.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Transfer the noodles into a baking pan.
Stir the sauce. Top with mozzarella and parmesan cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the cheese are melted.
Enjoy!​

name: Beef Lo Mein
ingredients: 1/2 lb beef sirloin, cut into strips
ingredientNames: 1/2 lb beef sirloin, cut into strips
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package direction. Set aside.
Combine beef, garlic, ginger and 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes. Mix well. Set aside.
Heat cooking oil in a wok over high heat.
Stir-fry the beef mixture. Cook until beef becomes tender. Transfer to a plate.
On the same wok, add water, soy sauce and 1/2 tsp pepper flakes. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Add the beef bullion cube then add the vegetables. Simmer covered for 3 minutes.
Stir in pasta. Simmer uncovered for 2 minutes.
Add the beef mixture. Simmer until beef is heated through.
Sprinkle with cilantro if desired.
​Enjoy!

name: Carbonara
ingredients: 1/2 cup - 3/4 cup shredded Parmesan cheese (adjust accordingly)
ingredientNames: 1/2 cup - 3/4 cup shredded Parmesan cheese (adjust accordingly)
instructions: Heat olive oil in saucepan over medium heat.
Saute onion and bacon, and cook until bacon is evenly browned.
Stir in garlic when bacon is about half done. Remove from heat.

name: Cheesy Chicken Pasta ( No-Bake)
ingredients: 1/2 lb chicken breast, cut into small strips or cubes
1 cup pasta sauce, any kind you choose
1/.2 cup mozarella cheese or 2 sticks or 3 slices
ingredientNames: 1/2 lb chicken breast, cut into small strips or cubes
1 cup pasta sauce, any kind you choose
1/.2 cup mozarella cheese or 2 sticks or 3 slices
instructions: Heat cooking oil in a pan or wok.
Add chicken breast and cook until no longer pink ( do not fully cook).
Add garlic and onion. Stir until just combined.
Add pasta sauce and water. Cover and bring to a boil.
Add oregano then morazella cheese. This will add thickness to the sauce. Season with additional salt and pepper if desired.
Add pasta. Cover and cook for about 15 minutes or until pasta is al dente.
Stir-in pepper flakes (optional). Add 1/2 cup mozarella cheese. Stir to combine.
Top with 1/2 cup shredded mozarella cheese. You can add more if desired.
Cover and cook until cheese is melted. About 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and enjoy.
Recipe yields 2-4 servings.​

name: Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: 1 lb or 16 oz fettuccine pasta or linguine
1 1/2 lbs chicken breast, sliced in half horizontally
1/3 cup fresh parsley, chopped (and more for topping)
ingredientNames: 1 lb or 16 oz fettuccine pasta or linguine
1 1/2 lbs chicken breast, sliced in half horizontally
1/3 cup fresh parsley, chopped (and more for topping)
instructions: Season both sides of sliced chicken breast with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Cook noodles according to package directions.  Cook it al dente or firm to the bite. Drain  and set aside.
While your pasta is cooking, you can start frying the chicken breast.

In a heated large pan over medium heat, melt butter then add oil. Combining the two avoids burning the butter.  Add marinated chicken breast.  Fry until cooked through. Remove from pan and slice diagonally or serving sized you desire.
Using the same pan, add onion. Cook until translucent.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add sliced mushrooms. Cook until lightly browned.
Pour heavy cream. Bring to a light boil.
Add chicken bouillon cube and cook for about 8 minutes.
Add chicken breasts, fresh parsley, salt and pepper. Stir to combine and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add cooked noodles. Stir until noodles are soaked in sauce and fully combined.
Turn off heat and cover. Let it rest for 10-15 minutes. This will allow the noodles to absorb the sauce.
Remove the cover and stir again to fully coat the noodles.
Serve on a plate and top with grated parmesan cheese and fresh parsley if desired.
Enjoy.

name: Chicken Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 cup chicken breast, cooked and shredded
8-10oz mararoni pasta, about 2 cups when cooked
1/2 cup cheddar cheese, cut into small cubes
ingredientNames: 1 cup chicken breast, cooked and shredded
8-10oz mararoni pasta, about 2 cups when cooked
1/2 cup cheddar cheese, cut into small cubes
instructions: In a small pot, boil the chicken breast and cook until tender, about 10-12 minutes. Remove from water and let it cool.  Using your hands, shred the chicken breast into thin strands. Set aside.

In a medium pot with boiling salted water and some oil, cook macaroni until al dente, about 8-9 minutes. Follow packaging instructions. Drain and rinse under cold water (to stop the cooking process and avoid sticking).
In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together until well combined.
Refrigerate for several hours before serving. It is best served when cold.
Recipe yields about 5 servings. You can double or triple the recipe if you are having a crowd.
Enjoy!

name: Chicken Sotanghon Soup
ingredients: 1 cup annatto extract  (1/3 cup sesame seeds  +  hot 1 cup chicken broth from reserved soup)
1/3 cup green onion or scallions, chopped
1 tbsp fish sauce (adjust to desired amount)
ingredientNames: 1 cup annatto extract  (1/3 cup sesame seeds  +  hot 1 cup chicken broth from reserved soup)
1/3 cup green onion or scallions, chopped
1 tbsp fish sauce (adjust to desired amount)
instructions: Add the rest of the reserved chicken broth. Let it boil.
Add the chicken cube and annatto extract. Continue boiling.
Add the sotanghon noodles  and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and cabbage. Cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, green onions  and toasted garlic. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Season with pepper and serve hot with boiled eggs if desired.
Enjoy.

name: Chicken Mami
ingredients: 1/2 lb or small piece chicken breast, bone-in
ingredientNames: 1/2 lb or small piece chicken breast, bone-in
instructions: Cook the noodles as per package direction.  Set aside.
Boil chicken breast in water and chicken broth and cook until tender.
Remove the chicken breast from the broth. Flake the chicken meat. Set aside.
Allow the broth to continue boiling. Season the broth with fish sauce or salt  then add pepper to taste.
Pour hot stock into each soup bowl with noodles.
Add chicken, cabbage, carrots & boiled eggs.
Top with green onions and garlic chips just before serving.
Serve hot.
Enjoy! ​

name: Chicken Sopas (Soup)
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni pasta, cooked al dente or medium firm
cooked chicken breast or left over roasted chicken, shredded or cut into serving pieces
ingredientNames: 2 cups macaroni pasta, cooked al dente or medium firm
cooked chicken breast or left over roasted chicken, shredded or cut into serving pieces
instructions: In a deep pan or wok, heat cooking oil then sauté the garlic and onion. Add the chicken.
When the chicken have slightly browned, add fish sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Add the water or chicken broth. Let it boil.
Add chicken cube, potatoes and carrots. Simmer until slightly tender.
Add the cooked macaroni pasta and cabbage. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Add milk and stir. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot. Enjoy!​

name: Creamy Carbonara
ingredients: 8 oz or 1 cup bacon cut into strips
2 cups heavy whipping cream or half & half
ingredientNames: 8 oz or 1 cup bacon cut into strips
2 cups heavy whipping cream or half & half
instructions: ​In a large pot, boil water and small amount of salt. I also add a little bit of oil. Cook spaghetti noodles until al dente. Make sure to follow packaging instructions. Remove from heat. Drain and set aside.

In a large wok, heat cooking oil and add onion. Cook until onion is translucent. Add bacon and cook until half done. Add garlic and continue cooking until bacon is evenly browned. Remove from heat then strain to discard oil.

Using the same pan, add heavy cream and egg yolks.  Bring to a light simmer. Add parmesan cheese and continue cooking for another 3-5 minutes . Add the cooked spaghetti and stir until noodles are covered with sauce. Turn off heat. Add bacon and season with ground pepper if desired. Stir again until well incorporated.
Transfer to a serving plate and top with more grated parmesan cheese if desired.
Enjoy!

name: Filipino Sweet Spaghetti
ingredients: 15-20 pieces Filipino red hot dogs (sliced diagonally)
3 cups or 35 oz Sweet Style Del Monte orUFC Spaghetti Sauce
3 cups or 3 (11.29 oz bottles) UFC banana sauce
3 -4 tbsp granulated sugar, adjust accordingly or omit if desired
1/3 cup grated cheese and more  for topping
ingredientNames: 15-20 pieces Filipino red hot dogs (sliced diagonally)
3 cups or 35 oz Sweet Style Del Monte orUFC Spaghetti Sauce
3 cups or 3 (11.29 oz bottles) UFC banana sauce
3 -4 tbsp granulated sugar, adjust accordingly or omit if desired
1/3 cup grated cheese and more  for topping
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a wok and saute garlic and onion. Cook until onion is soft and translucent.
Add the ground meat and continue cooking until the meat is no longer pink.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add the hot dogs. Cook for 8-10 minutes.
Add the spaghetti sauce, banana sauce and sugar.
Cook on low to medium heat while stirring occasionally for 15 minutes or until the sauce gets thick.
Season with salt & pepper if desired.
Serve with spaghetti noodles (see package directions in cooking the spaghetti noodles).
Top with grated cheese.
Enjoy!

name: Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
Cook noodles according to package instructions. Set aside.
In a large pan, saute garlic and onion in cooking oil.
Add ground beef and cook until color turns brown.
Add 1 1/2 jars marinara sauce. Simmer for 5-8 minutes. Set aside.
In a large bowl combine ricotta cheese, 3 1/2 cups mozarella cheese, parmesan cheese and eggs.
Grease a 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray.
Spread 3/4 cup Barilla sauce over the bottom of the greased baking dish.
Place 3-4 lasagna noodles over the bottom slightly  overlapping.
Spread half of the cheese mixture over noodles and cover with 1/2 of the meat sauce.
Repeat layers. Cover last layer of noodles with remaining meat sauce and cheese mixture.

name: Lasagna Roll Ups
ingredients: 10 lasagna noodles, prepared according to package directions
1 cup ricotta cheese or cottage cheese
3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese + 1/4 cup for topping
15 oz pasta sauce or 1/2 of 26 oz      (I used Hunts Four Cheese Pasta sauce)
ingredientNames: 10 lasagna noodles, prepared according to package directions
1 cup ricotta cheese or cottage cheese
3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese + 1/4 cup for topping
15 oz pasta sauce or 1/2 of 26 oz      (I used Hunts Four Cheese Pasta sauce)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Lightly grease a 13 x 9 baking pan with cooking spray or line with foil.
Add pasta sauce to lightly cover the bottom of baking dish.
In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, ground pepper, dried basil and garlic powder.
Spoon mixture evenly into a lasagna noodle, roll up tightly and arrange (seam down) in a prepared baking dish.
Pour remaining pasta sauce over rolled lasagna noodles.
Sprinkle top with mozzarella cheese and crushed red pepper flakes.
Cover with foil and bake for 20-25 minutes or until sauce is bubbly.
Remove from oven.
Serve and enjoy.

name: Meaty and Cheesy Lasagna Roll Ups
instructions: Spoon cheese mixture and meat evenly into a lasagna noodle, roll up tightly.
Add a small amount of meat with sauce on a 13 x 9 baking dish.
Arrange the rolled lasagna (seam down).
Pour remaining pasta sauce over rolled lasagna noodles.
Sprinkle top with mozzarella cheese.
Cover with foil and bake for 25-30 minutes or until sauce is bubbly.
Remove foil and bake for another 10 minutes or until cheese has melted.
Remove from oven. Enjoy :)

name: Pancit Bihon Guisado
ingredients: 1 lb pork  belly, cut into strips
1/2 head small cabbage, cut into squares
ingredientNames: 1 lb pork  belly, cut into strips
1/2 head small cabbage, cut into squares
instructions: Soak the rice sticks in lukewarm water for about 10 minutes.
In a large wok, saute garlic in cooking oil. Add onion, and cook  until onion is soft.
Add the pork . Cook until pork turns light brown.
Add the fish sauce, stir and cook for 1 minute.
Add 1/4 cup water and simmer until water is absorbed by the pork. Pork should be tender.
Add the green beans, carrots, cabbage and snow peas. Cook until vegetables are half-cooked. Empty the wok and set aside the pork and vegetables.
Using the same wok, boil soy sauce and broth. Add the rice sticks and cook until the rice sticks are tender and most of the broth is absorbed.
Add the cooked pork and vegetables then add the cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook for another 3 minutes.
Serve with calamansi or lemon.
Enjoy.

name: Pancit Canton
ingredients: 12 oz flour sticks or pancit canton noodles
1/2 lb pork belly cut into strips
1/2 cup medium sized shrimp shelled & deveined (optional)
3 1/2 cups pork broth or 3 1/2 cups water+1 pork cubes
ingredientNames: 12 oz flour sticks or pancit canton noodles
1/2 lb pork belly cut into strips
1/2 cup medium sized shrimp shelled & deveined (optional)
3 1/2 cups pork broth or 3 1/2 cups water+1 pork cubes
instructions: Blanch all the vegetables (carrots, snow peas, & cabbage) in a pan or wok.
In a separate wok, heat the cooking oil and saute garlic and onion.

name: Pancit Lomi
ingredients: 1/2 lb pork shoulder or butt, sliced into strips
1 cup squid balls, sliced in half
3 tbsp cornstarch dissolved in 1/4 cup water
ingredientNames: 1/2 lb pork shoulder or butt, sliced into strips
1 cup squid balls, sliced in half
3 tbsp cornstarch dissolved in 1/4 cup water
instructions: Prepare pork broth by boiling pork bones in 10 cups water with 2 tsp salt. Boil for one hour more.
In a large deep pan or wok (without oil), fry pork strips until oil comes out and pork turns light brown. Season with salt if desired. Remove from pan and set aside.
Add squid balls and cook for about 1-2 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside.
Add 1-2 tbsp cooking oil. Add liver and cook until tender. Season with salt if desired. Do not overcook. Remove from pan and set aside.
Add garlic and saute until fragrant.
Add onion and cook until translucent.
Add pork broth. Bring to a boil.
Add pork cube, half of cooked pork, half of cooked liver and half of cooked squid balls. (Save the rest for topping when serving).
Add carrot, soy sauce and noodles. Bring to a boil.
Add dissolved cornstarch. Stir to combine.
Add beaten eggs and stir. Sauce will start to thicken.
Add cabbage. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for one more minute.
Remove from heat and serve.
Enjoy.

name: Pancit Palabok
instructions: In a pan with tap water, submerge the rice sticks for 30 minutes.
Place the noodles in a strainer and submerge in boiling water (about 195F-200F) for 2 minutes or until the noodles are cooked or al dente. Do not overcook to avoid soggy noodles.
Drain the noodles and transfer to a serving plate.
Pour the Palabok sauce and garnish with the toppings.
Squeeze some lemon or calamansi if preferred.
Serve and enjoy.

name: Parmesan Shrimp Pasta
ingredients: 12-16 oz shrimp (medium or large), tail-on, peeled and deveined
1 cup frozen peas, thawed or green peas from the can.
12 oz pasta cooked according to package instructions (I used bowties)
ingredientNames: 12-16 oz shrimp (medium or large), tail-on, peeled and deveined
1 cup frozen peas, thawed or green peas from the can.
12 oz pasta cooked according to package instructions (I used bowties)
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions. Set aside.
Melt the butter in a pan then add olive oil.
Add green peas and shrimp. Cover and cook for 1 minute.
Put-in the garlic. Continue to cook for 2 minutes.
Gradually add-in the cooked pasta or noodles.
Toss until all the ingredients are incorporated.
Add the oregano, parmesan cheese, and ground black pepper.
Toss again until all are well distributed.
Serve with your favorite sides like garlic bread.
Enjoy!

name: Penne with Bechamel Sauce
ingredients: 500 grams Penne Rigate or pasta of choice
4 cups or 1 kg spaghetti or pasta sauce ( I used UFC Sweet Spaghetti Sauce)
ingredientNames: 500 grams Penne Rigate or pasta of choice
4 cups or 1 kg spaghetti or pasta sauce ( I used UFC Sweet Spaghetti Sauce)
instructions: Here's how I prepare my pasta. Boil water with a small amount of salt and oil. After the recommended cooking time, rinse the pasta in cold water to stop the cooking process. It will stay firm and will avoid sticking together.
You can use any pasta you desire and omit the banana sauce and condensed milk on this recipe. The good thing about making pasta, it is so simple and you can adjust according to your liking.
You can also bake this recipe after adding the sauce but you don't have to. Bake at 350F for 5-10 minutes or warm it up in the microwave for few minutes. ​

name: Pinoy Style Spaghetti
ingredients: 32 oz spaghetti sauce, use Hunts brand- Four Cheese or 35 oz Sweet Style Del Monte Spaghetti Sauce
4 small bottles of banana sauce (I used UFC taming-anghang banana catsup)
ingredientNames: 32 oz spaghetti sauce, use Hunts brand- Four Cheese or 35 oz Sweet Style Del Monte Spaghetti Sauce
4 small bottles of banana sauce (I used UFC taming-anghang banana catsup)
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a wok and saute garlic and onion.
Add the ground meat and continue cooking until the meat turns light.
Add the fish sauce and the hotdog. Cook for 8-10 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, spaghetti sauce, banana sauce and sugar.
Cook on medium heat while stirring occasionally for 15 minutes or until the sauce gets thick.
Season with salt & pepper.
Serve with spaghetti noodles (see package directions in cooking the spaghetti noodles).
Top with grated cheese.
Enjoy!​

name: Shrimp Fettucini Alfredo
instructions: Boil a large pot of water. Cook pasta for 10 minutes or until al dente.
Drain pasta. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk together egg yolks, heavy cream, and shredded parmesan. Set aside.
Heat butter in a pan over medium heat.
Saute onion and shrimp. Cook for 2 minutes.
Pour-in prepared sauce mixture.
Add the broccoli. Bring to a simmer. Cook until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve fresh pasta topped with alfredo sauce.
Enjoy!​

name: Chicken Sotanghon Soup
ingredients: 1 cup annatto extract  (1/3 cup sesame seeds  +  hot 1 cup chicken broth from reserved soup)
1/3 cup green onion or scallions, chopped
1 tbsp fish sauce (adjust to desired amount)
ingredientNames: 1 cup annatto extract  (1/3 cup sesame seeds  +  hot 1 cup chicken broth from reserved soup)
1/3 cup green onion or scallions, chopped
1 tbsp fish sauce (adjust to desired amount)
instructions: Add the rest of the reserved chicken broth. Let it boil.
Add the chicken cube and annatto extract. Continue boiling.
Add the sotanghon noodles  and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and cabbage. Cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, green onions  and toasted garlic. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Season with pepper and serve hot with boiled eggs if desired.
Enjoy.

name: Spaghetti
ingredients: 32 oz spaghetti sauce ( I use Hunts brand- Four Cheese)
3 small bottles of banana ketchup (I use UFC tamis anghang banana ketchup)
ingredientNames: 32 oz spaghetti sauce ( I use Hunts brand- Four Cheese)
3 small bottles of banana ketchup (I use UFC tamis anghang banana ketchup)
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a wok and saute garlic and onion.
Add the ground pork and continue cooking until the meat turns light.
Add the fish sauce then add the hotdogs. Cook for 8-10 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, spaghetti sauce, liver spread, ketchup and sugar.
Cook on medium heat while stirring occasionally for 15 minutes or until the sauce gets thick.
Season with salt & pepper.
Serve with spaghetti noodles (see package directions in cooking the spaghetti noodles).
Top with grated cheese. Enjoy!

name: Sparoni (Spaghetti Macaroni)
ingredients: 1 package (16oz) macaroni noodles (cook per package directions)
32 oz spaghetti sauce (I use Hunts brand)
4 small bottles of banana ketchup (I use UFC tamis anghang banana ketchup)
ingredientNames: 1 package (16oz) macaroni noodles (cook per package directions)
32 oz spaghetti sauce (I use Hunts brand)
4 small bottles of banana ketchup (I use UFC tamis anghang banana ketchup)
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a wok and saute garlic and onion.
Add the ground pork and continue cooking until the meat turns light.
Add the fish sauce and the hotdog. Cook for 8-10 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, spaghetti sauce and ketchup.
Cook on medium heat while constantly stirring for 15-20 minutes or until the sauce gets thick.
Season with salt & pepper.
Pour-in sauce to the macaroni noodles. (Cook macaroni noodles per package directions.)
Top with grated cheese.
Enjoy!

name: Stuffed Manicotti
ingredients: 7 pieces manicotti noodles, prepared according to package directions
1 cup ricotta cheese or cottage cheese
3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese + 1/4 cup for topping
15 oz pasta sauce or 1/2 of 26 oz      (I used Hunts Four Cheese Pasta sauce)
ingredientNames: 7 pieces manicotti noodles, prepared according to package directions
1 cup ricotta cheese or cottage cheese
3/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese + 1/4 cup for topping
15 oz pasta sauce or 1/2 of 26 oz      (I used Hunts Four Cheese Pasta sauce)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Lightly grease a 13 x 9 baking pan with cooking spray.
Add pasta sauce to lightly cover the bottom of baking dish.
In a medium bowl, combine chopped spinach, ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, ground pepper, dried basil and garlic powder.
Fill the manicotti with the mixture (I used a teaspoon) and arrange in a prepared baking dish.
Pour remaining pasta sauce over rolled lasagna noodles.
Sprinkle top with mozzarella cheese and crushed red pepper flakes.
Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes or until sauce is bubbly.
Remove from oven.

name: Arrozcaldo​
ingredients: 7 cups chicken broth OR 7 cups water+ 1 chicken cube
1 cup glutinous or sticky rice (uncooked) or regular rice
ingredientNames: 7 cups chicken broth OR 7 cups water+ 1 chicken cube
1 cup glutinous or sticky rice (uncooked) or regular rice
instructions: In a wok with heated cooking oil, saute' garlic and cook until color turns light brown.
Add onion and ginger. Cook until onions are translucent.
Add the chicken and cook until chicken turns light brown in color.
Add the fish sauce. Cook for few minutes.
Add the chicken broth. Bring to a boil.
Add the uncooked rice. Stir occasionally until the rice is cooked.
Add saffron, ground black pepper and boiled eggs. Cook for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving bowl and top with green onions, fried garlic and squeeze some lemon.
Serve and enjoy!​

name: Bibingka
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh milk or evaporated milk
1/4 cup softened butter  + additional for brushing
1 salted egg, sliced or cream cheese, sliced
ingredientNames: 1/4 cup fresh milk or evaporated milk
1/4 cup softened butter  + additional for brushing
1 salted egg, sliced or cream cheese, sliced
instructions: Combine butter and sugar together while whisking then add the eggs.
Gradually add the rice flour and baking powder.
Add the coconut milk and fresh milk. Beat well until smooth.
Line molds or round pans with pliable banana leaves (brushed with butter).
Pour mixture in the prepared molds or muffin pans.
Bake in (preheated ) oven 375 degrees F for 20 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Top with sliced salted eggs, grated cheese or cream cheese.
Bake again for 5-10 minutes or until the color of top turns medium brown.
Remove from oven. Brush some butter on top if desired.
Serve or top with grated coconut.
Enjoy!

name: Bibingkang Malagkit
instructions: Rinse the rice until water runs clear.
Add 2 cups water. Cook over medium heat  and bring to a boil.  Reduce the heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes or until water dries out.
In a pan, add coconut milk. Add granulated sugar. Stir to dissolve the sugar. Bring to a simmer.
Add the cooked sweet rice. Stir constantly until all the liquid is absorbed by the rice. Mixture will be very sticky and hard to stir.
Transfer to a 9" pan lined with softened banana leaves.
Preheat oven to 375 F.
In a pan, combine coconut milk and brown sugar. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and continue cooking until mixture becomes thick and has caramelized.
Pour the mixture on top of the Bibingkang Malagkit.
Bake for 30-45 minutes or until the top starts to bubble and turns darker in color.
Serve and enjoy.

name: Biko with Langka
ingredients: 1 can, 560 ml  or 15 oz can coconut cream
1/2 cup langka / jackfruit pulp in syrup, sliced into strips
1 can, 560 ml or 15 oz coconut cream for Latik (curd coconut cream)
ingredientNames: 1 can, 560 ml  or 15 oz can coconut cream
1/2 cup langka / jackfruit pulp in syrup, sliced into strips
1 can, 560 ml or 15 oz coconut cream for Latik (curd coconut cream)
instructions: Heat coconut cream in a pan. Bring to a boil.
When it's almost dry, stir until the milk turns into oil and leave a solid residue.
If it doesn't turn into oil or the brand that you use doesn't have a lot of oil, then you can add about 1-2 tbsp vegetable oil.​
Continue cooking until the solid residue becomes light brown in color.

name: Biko with Munggo
ingredients: 1 can, 560 ml  or 15 oz can coconut cream
1 cup brown sugar​ (add 1/2 cup if you prefer it sweet)
1 can, 560 ml or 15 oz coconut cream for Latik
ingredientNames: 1 can, 560 ml  or 15 oz can coconut cream
1 cup brown sugar​ (add 1/2 cup if you prefer it sweet)
1 can, 560 ml or 15 oz coconut cream for Latik
instructions: Heat coconut cream in a pan. Bring to a boil.
When it's almost dry, stir until the milk turns into oil and leave a solid residue.
If it doesn't turn into oil or the brand that you use doesn't have a lot of oil, then you can add about 1-2 tbsp vegetable oil.​
Continue cooking until the solid residue becomes light brown in color.

name: Biko Pandan
ingredients: 2 tsp pandan essence. (Add green food color if essence is clear)
1 can coconut cream for latik topping
Banana leaf for lining the tray (optional)
ingredientNames: 2 tsp pandan essence. (Add green food color if essence is clear)
1 can coconut cream for latik topping
Banana leaf for lining the tray (optional)
instructions: Heat coconut milk in a pan. Bring to a boil.
When it's almost dry, stir until the milk turns into oil and leave a solid residue.
If it doesn't turn into oil or the brand that you use doesn't have a lot of oil, then you can add 1 tbsp of vegetable oil.

name: California Sushi Bowl
ingredients: 1 to 1-1/2 cups imitation crabs, flaked or slice diagonally or cubed
1 tbsp furikake rice seasoning plus extra for sprinkling
ingredientNames: 1 to 1-1/2 cups imitation crabs, flaked or slice diagonally or cubed
1 tbsp furikake rice seasoning plus extra for sprinkling
instructions: Combine crabs, cucumber, carrots, avocado and furikake. Gently toss together until fully incorporated.
In a small bowl, stir together soy sauce and 1 tbsp rice vinegar. Set aside.
Using a rice spatula, loosen the cooked rice.
In a small bowl, combine 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar and 1/4 tsp salt. Microwave for about 30 seconds or until sugar is fully dissolved.
Pour over the rice and stir until combined.

Divide the seasoned rice into four and scoop into bowls. Top with the prepared topping ingredients and drizzle about 1/2 tbsp soy sauce-vinegar mixture. Season with furikake and top with mayonnaise (about 1 tbsp) and sriracha sauce (about 1 tsp).
Serve and enjoy.
Makes 4 California Sushi Bowls.

name: Champorado
instructions: Rinse the rice until water runs clear.
In a pot, boil the rice and water.
Bring to a boil, cook in low heat for about 15 minutes (or until the glutinous rice is cooked) while constantly stirring.
Add the cocoa powder, sugar and vanilla.
Cook for another 5 minutes or until the texture becomes thick.
Remove from heat.
Transfer to a serving bowl and top with condensed milk.
Enjoy!

name: Cheesy Bibingka Cake
ingredients: 3/4 - 1 cup grated cheddar cheese  plus more for topping
1 piece thinly sliced salted egg for topping
ingredientNames: 3/4 - 1 cup grated cheddar cheese  plus more for topping
1 piece thinly sliced salted egg for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F.

Make the banana leaf pliable by passing it lightly over a low flame. This will soften the leaf and will allow you to line an 8 inches pan with ease and without tearing it. Brush the leaf with oil or butter. If banana leaf is not available, you can just use a parchment greased with butter.
In a large bowl. cream the butter.  Add the sugar until light and fluffy.  Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition.

Place a sieve over the bowl and sift together all-purpose flour, rice flour, baking powder, and salt. Beat lightly until just combined. Add the coconut milk and water. Stir-in grated cheese.  Pour the mixture onto the prepared pan.
To BAKE: Bake for about 20-25 minutes. Remove from the oven. Top with grated cheese and salted egg. Return to the oven and bake for another 20 minutes or until set and top starts to turn golden.

To STEAM: Prepare a steamer by boiling water.  Steam over medium-low heat for about 20-25 minutes. Make sure to cover the lid with a cloth to avoid water drips. Remove the lid and top the Bibingka with grated cheese and salted egg. Return to the oven and bake for another 15-20 minutes or until set and top starts to turn golden.
Immediately brush the top with butter. Let cook for a little bit. Serve with fresh grated coconut. Best eaten warm.  Enjoy!

name: Coconut Rice Sticks
instructions: Make sure the oil is hot enough before adding the glutinous rice sticks. To test the oil if ready, place the tip of a wooden spoon or chopstick on the oil and if bubbles form around it, the oil is ready.

Mixture should form a dough. If it is too crumbly add a small amount of water.  If is it too wet, add flour. Add a tsp at a time. Adjust the flour and water as needed. You should be able to easily form the dough into logs.
The coconut glutinous rice sticks can be eaten without caramel coating. Personally. I like it that way.
Once done, they have to be consumed immediately.

name: ​Espasol
ingredients: 1/8 cup or 1/4 cup water (if needed), adjust accordingly
ingredientNames: 1/8 cup or 1/4 cup water (if needed), adjust accordingly
instructions: Transfer the mixture into a board, flat surface or tray dusted with toasted flour.
Divide the mixture into parts or sizes according to your preference.
Roll over the sliced mixture into the toasted flour.
Enjoy!​

name: ​Ginataang Bilo-Bilo
ingredients: 1-1/4  to 1-1/2 cups water, adjust as needed
1 cup sweetened jackfruit, sliced into strips
ingredientNames: 1-1/4  to 1-1/2 cups water, adjust as needed
1 cup sweetened jackfruit, sliced into strips
instructions: If you happen to combine flour and water all at once and the mixture becomes very sticky, don't worry, you can always adjust it. No exact measurement here because the goal is to make a dough. Not too sticky but not hard or dry or they will crumble when rolled.  I noticed that different brands of glutinous rice flour have different water absorption so you need to adjust them as needed.
Ube food color is optional. You can omit if desired and just make them all plain. I thought of adding ube flavor to add some flavor and color as well. It looks more appetizing when ube is added.
The coconut cream will continue to thicken as it cools.
Leftover can be stored in the refrigerator in an airtight container for up to 3 days. To reheat, microwave a bowl of Bilo-Bilo for about 1-2 minutes.
To cook the mini sago or tapiocal pearls, boil water in a pot. Add sago and boil the pearls until cooked or color becomes clear about 12 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water. Set aside.
I used sweetened jackfruit in syrup that's in a small bottle when purchased.

name: Ginataang Mais
ingredients: 1 can, 400 ml or 13.5 oz coconut milk
1 can, 15 oz 432 grams cream corn or whole corn kernels
ingredientNames: 1 can, 400 ml or 13.5 oz coconut milk
1 can, 15 oz 432 grams cream corn or whole corn kernels
instructions: Rinse glutinous rice until water runs clear.
In a pot, combine rinsed glutinous rice and water.
Simmer to boil until rice is half cooked. Stir occasionally to avoid sticking.
Add the coconut milk. Bring back to boil.
Add sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved.
Add cream corn and cook for 15-20 minutes or until desired consistency is achieved.
Serve warm or cold.
Enjoy.

name: Kakanin Butsi
ingredients: 200 grams / 7 oz green mung beans / munggo
3 cans (13.5 fl oz each) and 3/4 cups coconut milk
ingredientNames: 200 grams / 7 oz green mung beans / munggo
3 cans (13.5 fl oz each) and 3/4 cups coconut milk
instructions: In a small pot, cook mung beans in 1/3 cup sugar and water. (sugar is optional)
Boil until mung beans are cooked and water has evaporated. Set aside.
In a wok, combine glutinous rice flour, coconut milk and 1/4 cup sugar.
Simmer in low heat while continuously stirring until it thickens. Set aside.
Preheat oven to 450 F.
Grease a 13 x 9 baking pan with a non-stick cooking spray or brush with butter.
Spread half  of the glutinous rice-coconut milk mixture.
In a small bowl combine coconut milk and condensed milk. Mix well.
Spread half of the coconut milk-condensed milk mixture on top of the glutinous rice-coconut milk mixture.
Form mung beans balls on top or you can spread  them over the prepared mixture.
Spread the rest of the glutinous rice-coconut milk mixture on top of the mung beans balls to cover them.
Then, the rest of the coconut milk-condensed milk mixture on top.
Bake in the oven at  for 30-40 minutes or until top of the mixture becomes golden brown.
Serve warm or cold.
Enjoy!​ ​

name: Kalamay Kapit
instructions: Prepare the latik by heating coconut milk or cream in a pan. Bring to a boil.  Lightly stir if bottom or sides of pan starts to brown. Milk will turn into solid and oil will separate. Cook until golden brown. Set aside.
Note: If the brand that you used did not turn into oil, you can add 2 tbsp vegetable oil to the solid residue and cook until light the color turns light brown in color.​ ​​Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine glutinous rice flour and sugar.
Add coconut milk. Mix until fully incorporated and batter becomes smooth.
Transfer the mixture to  an 8 "or 9" round or square cake pan lined with parchment paper.
Steam for 30 minutes over medium heat.
Transfer the still-warm rice cake on a 13 X 9 tray (Invert over the tray) and remove parchment paper.
Flatten with a rolling pin greased with oil. Shape into a rectangle.
Spread the middle part with ube jam / ube halaya.
Add some sweet jackfruit or langka strips.
Roll into a log and cool completely.
Slice into serving portions.
Top with jackfruit strips, jackfruit syrup and latik.
Enjoy.​​

name: Kakanin Lansong
ingredients: 1 can, 15 oz or 1 3/4 cups coconut milk
1 can, 15 oz or 19 oz  coconut cream for Latik
ingredientNames: 1 can, 15 oz or 1 3/4 cups coconut milk
1 can, 15 oz or 19 oz  coconut cream for Latik
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine glutinous rice flour and sugar.
Add coconut milk. Mix until fully incorporated and batter becomes smooth.
Grease an 8 "or 9" round cake pan with oil from latik. If banana leaf is available, I highly suggest to use one then grease with oil from latik.
Transfer the mixture to a greased pan.
Steam for 30 minutes over medium heat.
Top with prepared latik.
Serve warm.

name: Kakanin Munggo
instructions: If the beans are not soft enough after all the water has evaporated, you can always add water and continue boiling. The goal is make it really soft.
For the coconut milk and condensed milk topping, you can do 1 cup coconut milk instead of 1 can. I've tried it before and that's fine. I just love it with more coconut milk.
This can also be baked at 425F for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes or until top is somewhat charred.

Any leftover can be stored in the refrigerator and consume within 3 days. Make sure to wipe the container's lid if there are any moisture as this causes for shorter shelf life due to the coconut milk.
It can be eaten cold straight out from the refrigerator. Personally, I prefer it cold than warm.
Microwave for 30 seconds to 1 minute if you like it warm.

name: Kalamay Ube
instructions: Heat coconut milk in a pan. Bring to a boil.Keep stirring for about 15-20 minutes until the milk turned into oil and leave a solid residue.
Heat coconut milk in a pan. Bring to a boil.
Keep stirring for about 15-20 minutes until the milk turned into oil and leave a solid residue.

name: Inutak
instructions: Brush llanera or baking pan with butter. ( I used 3 llanera molds for this recipe).
Transfer the purple mixture into the prepared pans or molds.
Scoop the white mixture on top of purple yam mixture to create two layers. Press and smoothen the top to flatten.
Pour about 2-2 1/2 tbsp coconut cream onto each filled llanera.
Broil for 15-20 or until the top has browned or charred. Make sure to check before the set time as oven temperature varies.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
instructions: Soak rice in water for at least 6 hours or overnight. Drain and rinse thoroughly. Place the soaked rice in a steamer lined with banana leaf or muslin cloth/cheese cloth or tea towel. Add pandan leaf (cut into small pieces). Cover and steam over a medium heat for 25 minutes or until tender.
In a small sauce pan, combine coconut milk, sugar salt and pandan leaf.  Bring to a simmer for 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Pour the coconut sauce onto the hot steamed rice. Mix and set aside for 10 minutes.
Cook remaining coconut sauce over low heat.
Combine cornstarch and water. Add to coconut sauce and cook for 3 minutes or until sauce thickens.
Serve rice with coconut sauce and fresh cut ripe mangoes.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds.
Enjoy!

name: Mini Sapin-Sapin
instructions: Prepare the steamer and bring the water to a boil.  ​Make sure the steamer lid is covered with cheese cloth to avoid water drips.
Pour about 1 tablespoonful of ube mixture in the prepared molds, and steam for about 5 minutes or until it firms up. Stick a toothpick and make sure it comes out clean.
Add 1 tablespoonful of white mixture over the purple mixture and steam for another 5 minutes or until it firms up. Stick a toothpick and make sure it comes out clean.
Add 1 tablespoonful yellow mixture on top of the white mixture and steam for another 3-5 minutes or until it sets.
Carefully remove from steamer, let it cool  completely and run a spatula (greased with oil) on the sides of the mini rice cake to loosen and transfer to a serving plate.
Top with Latik.
Enjoy! ​​​

name: Mochi Waffles
ingredients: 1/2 tsp ube extract or pandan extract
ingredientNames: 1/2 tsp ube extract or pandan extract
instructions: You can also just make the waffle plain then drizzle with ube or pandan extract.
If Waffle Maker is not available, you can make Mochi Pancakes instead. Just add 1/4 cup all-purpose flour to the dry ingredients.
Make sure to great the waffle maker or pan (if making pancakes) to avoid sticking.

name: Native Kutsinta
instructions: Do not use tap or cold water. Lukewarm helps the flour dissolve faster.  If cold, you'll end up with more lumps.

I lined my round pan with parchment paper instead of greasing the pan with oil. Based on my experience,  even if you do, it will still slightly stick and will be a little challenge to unmold. Unless you have a plastic container that's heat-proof the that should be fine. Also for me, using a parchment paper is easy clean up. What I did was when it has cooled down, I removed the sides of the parchment paper and left the bottom on so I can easily transfer it to the bilao (wicker tray) with banana leaf. Makes it more native.
Annatto or Achiote (Achuete) is optional but great to have to achieve a nice darker top.

Lye water is essential for this recipe. It makes the kutsinta chewy. I have read about substituting it with baking soda that's boiled in water but it really doesn't provide the same result when using lye water.  If you want to make a good Kutsinta, make sure to have it. But store it in a place where children can't reach as it is harmful if consumed in large amount.
After steaming, it is normal to have slight liquid on on top . Let it air dry. If it looks like it is water drip from the lid, you can just scoop it out with a spoon.

This recipe is best served with fresh grated coconut. Without it, it's just not complete. Here in California, I can find frozen grated coconut and I just thaw it. Like fresh when ready to use. If not available, some serve it with coconut jam or yema.

name: Palitaw
instructions: Combine glutinous rice flour and water. Adjust the water as needed. Mix until a dough is formed.
Take about 1 tablespoon of the dough and flatten with your thumb.
Boil water in a pot and drop each dough into the boiling water. Dough is cooked when they start to float.
Remove and set aside. Allow to dry  and cool down.
In a small pan, toast the sesame seeds.
Combine toasted sesame seeds and sugar. Set aside.
Coat the cooked dough with grated coconut then add the sesame sugar mixture.
Enjoy.

name: Palitaw
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a pan. Add the sesame seeds. Toast until brown.
Combine sugar, coconut flakes and toasted sesame seeds. Set aside.
Combine glutinous rice flour and water until a dough is formed.
Take about a tablespoon of the dough and shape it into a ball then flatten the middle of the dough with your thumb.
Boil water in a pot. Drop in the dough in boiling water; wait until dough floats.
Remove and set aside. Allow the dough to dry out and cool down.
Roll the dough in coconut mixture.
Serve and Enjoy!

name: ​Purple Sweet Potato Rice Cake
ingredients: 1 cup purple yam, boiled and mashed
ingredientNames: 1 cup purple yam, boiled and mashed
instructions: Combine yam, 4 tbsp sugar and condensed milk
Shape into round balls. Set aside.
Combine glutinous rice flour, 4 tbsp sugar and water. Adjust the flour and water accordingly. (Mixture cannot be too dry or too sticky.)
Scoop dough then flatten each dough with your fingers to make a round shape.
Place about purple yam ball on the center.
Gather all the sides and pinch together. Seal well.
Press with the palm of your hand to make a round flat shape.
Press the shaped dough against the sesame seeds.
Heat a pan with a small amount of cooking oil.
Pan fry until sides are brown.
Serve alone or with sweetened coconut flakes or fresh grated coconut with sugar.
Enjoy.
Heat the cooking oil in a pan. Add the sesame seeds. Toast until brown.
Combine sugar, coconut flakes and toasted sesame seeds. Set aside.
Combine glutinous rice flour and water until a dough is formed.
Take about a tablespoon of the dough and shape it into a ball then flatten the middle of the dough with your thumb.
Boil water in a pot. Drop in the dough in boiling water; wait until dough floats.
Remove and set aside. Allow the dough to dry out and cool down.
Roll the dough in coconut mixture.
Serve and Enjoy!

name: Puto
instructions: Click here to watch on Facebook how I made this delicious Puto Cheese.
In a medium mixing bowl, sift the rice flour and white sugar.
Put-in salt and baking powder.
Add coconut milk and anise seeds (optional). Mix and blend thoroughly until mixture is smooth.
Grease the muffin pans with butter or put paper cups into the muffin pans. I used silicone baking cups. Please find Amazon link above.
Pour the mixture into the muffin pans and fill up to 2/3 full.
Steam for about 15 minutes.
Add cheese on top then continue steaming for another 10 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Serve warm.
Enjoy!​ ​​

name: Puto Cheese
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, sift the rice flour and white sugar.
Put-in salt and baking powder.
Add coconut milk and anise seeds (optional). Mix and blend thoroughly until mixture is smooth.
Grease the muffin pans with butter or put paper cups into the muffin pans. I used silicone baking cups. Please find Amazon link above.
Pour the mixture into the muffin pans and fill up to 2/3 full.
Steam for about 15 minutes.
Add cheese on top then continue steaming for another 10 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Serve warm.
Enjoy!

name: Putong Bigas
ingredients: Special Puto Cupcakes with Salted Egg
ingredientNames: Special Puto Cupcakes with Salted Egg
instructions: Rinse the rice with water until water runs clear. Add water and soak the rice for at least 6 hours or overnight.
Drain the water and reserve 1 cup.

Transfer the soaked rice to a blender. Add 1 cup reserved water and 1/4 cup sugar. Blend for about 3-5 minutes. Scrape the sides of the blender then add the cooked rice (leftover cold rice). Continue blending until mixture is smooth.
Pass through a sieve then strain.
Add 3/4 cup sugar and salt. Stir until sugar and salt are fully dissolved.
Add baking powder and mix until just combined. Do not over mix.
Rest the batter for 15-30 minutes.
Heat water in a steamer. Prepare the molds by lightly greasing with oil or butter.
Fill the molds with batter about 3/4 full. Transfer the cups with batter in a steamer pan.

Steam for about 20-22 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out almost clean. (Some dry crumbs are normal.) - Make sure the steamer lid is covered with a cloth to avoid water dripping from the lid.
You can remove them immediately from molds or let cool first. It's up to you.
Top with grated cheese or serve with fresh grated coconut if you like.
Recipe yields about 20 pieces.

name: Putong Bigas with Gata (Coconut Milk)
ingredients: Special Puto Cupcakes with Salted Egg
ingredientNames: Special Puto Cupcakes with Salted Egg
instructions: Make sure your water is already boiling before you place your puto
Set heat to medium
Cover your steamer lid with a towel or cloth to avoid steam dropping back on top of your puto
Batter consistency should be not too thick nor too thin
Rest your blender every now and then to avoid overheating
Sprinkle with anise seeds (if available) before steaming to achieve a licorice flavor (this is the traditional putong bigas topping, served with grated coconut)
Avoid using cupcake liners as your streamed batter will only stick to it
By using silicone moulds or traditional puto moulds, not only can you remove your puto without sticking, but you can remove them even while still hot.
Serve topped with grated cheese or freshly grated coconut.
Recipe yields about 25-30 pieces.

name: Rice Puto with Cheese
ingredients: Special Puto Cupcakes with Salted Egg​
ingredientNames: Special Puto Cupcakes with Salted Egg​
instructions: I used 3oz (large puto moulds). If you will be using the 2oz or the small one, you can steam it for 5 minutes, add the cheese then continue steaming for another 10 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out almost clean (dry crumbs are okay).

If these puto moulds (I got from the Philippines) are not available, you can also use the silicone muffins cups or tart molds. Just make sure to grease it first or use a cupcake liner for easy cleaning.
As you can see, this puto has cracks on top. It is due to the heat or fire was set on medium-high heat. If you want a smoother top, set your heat to medium-low.
If anise seeds are available, you can add some, about 1/2- 1 tsp in the mixture if you like.  it will add some aroma and flavor to it.
Make sure to check the label of your flour if it says Rice Flour.  If it says glutinous rice flour, do not use it.
I used Eden cheese for this recipe. you can also use other cheese as you wish as long as they are not quick melt. You can also use salted egg or cream cheese.
Puto is best served the same day but you can store them in airtight container and refrigerate. You can re-steam or microwave for few seconds.

name: Sapin-Sapin
ingredients: ube/purple food coloring, I used McCormick Ube Flavor
ingredientNames: ube/purple food coloring, I used McCormick Ube Flavor
instructions: ​Heat coconut cream in a pan. Bring to a boil.
When it's almost dry, stir until the milk turns into oil and leave a solid residue.
If it doesn't turn into oil or the brand that you use doesn't have a lot of oil, then you can add about 1-2 tbsp vegetable oil.​

name: Special Bibingka
ingredients: 1/4 cup softened butter plus extra for coating
grated cheese for toppings, salted egg, sliced or cream cheese, sliced
ingredientNames: 1/4 cup softened butter plus extra for coating
grated cheese for toppings, salted egg, sliced or cream cheese, sliced
instructions: Because oven temperature varies, I suggest  to always check your bibingka before the set time to avoid over baking.
If banana leaves are not available, you may use a regular cupcake liner.
If you would like to coat the top with melted butter, you may do so.

Toppings are flexible. You can omit the salted eggs and replaced with a slice of cream cheese. You can add them even before the bibingka sets, say about after 15 minutes, you can add it and your slice of cheese filling will be in the middle.

name: Suman Malagkit
instructions: Set up the steamer. Arrange the wrapped mixture into the steamer. Single layer or on top of each other.
Steam over medium heat for about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Remove from steamer.
Serve with plain sugar, ube jam or caramel sauce. To make the caramel sauce, combine all ingredients in small pan and cook until sauce is thick.
Enjoy.

name: Suman Malagkit
instructions: Prepare the banana leaves by wiping away any white residues with a damp cloth.
Remove the spine and trim (size preference).
Scoop the rice mixture and place it over the prepared banana leaves.
Start rolling to secure the rice mixture and fold the sides.
Repeat until rice mixture is finished. Set up the steamer.
Arrange the wrapped mixture into the steamer. Single layer or on top of each other.
Steam over medium heat for about 45 minutes.
Remove from steamer.
Serve with sugar if you prefer.
​Enjoy.

name: Suman sa Lihiya
ingredients: banana leaves for wrapping - cleaned and cut into two sizes (approximately 8x11 and 4x5)
kitchen twine or thin cotton strings to tie or banana leaves stripped into thin long pieces
ingredientNames: banana leaves for wrapping - cleaned and cut into two sizes (approximately 8x11 and 4x5)
kitchen twine or thin cotton strings to tie or banana leaves stripped into thin long pieces
instructions: Soak the glutinous rice in water for about 2-3 hours.
Drain and mix in the lye water. It should turn yellowish. Mix well.
Arrange the banana leaves by placing the larger leaf first in a flat surface then put the smaller leaf in the center of the larger leaf. (see picture#2)
Place about 3 tablespoonfuls of the glutinous rice mixture on the smaller piece of leaf.
Grab the 2 long sides of the bigger piece and bring them together. Fold or roll that side to enclose the rice (about 3 half-inch folds). It is now long and narrow shaped.
Fold about the lower 1/4 of the parcel towards the center.
While firmly holding the folded end of the parcel, put it upright and tap it on the table to pack in the rice and if need be add more rice through the open end.
Fold the top end towards the center.
Make another one of roughly the same size. Pair these two with the folded sides together.
Using thin cotton strings or kitchen twine to tie the two ends together tightly. ( I used banana leaves see pic.)
Place the assembled pieces in a big pot and add enough water to cover the suman.
Bring to boil and bring down heat to low and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours.
Serve warm or cold with grated coconut and sugar. (I used sweetened coconut flakes and brown sugar instead.)​

name: Suman sa Lihiya with Coconut Caramel Sauce
instructions: ​​​Make another one of roughly the same size. Pair these two with the folded sides together.​
Using thin cotton strings or kitchen twine to tie the two ends together tightly. ( I used banana leaves)
Place the assembled pieces in a big pot and add enough water to cover the suman.
Bring to boil and bring down heat to low and simmer for about 1 hour.
Serve warm or cold with coconut caramel sauce. To make the caramel sauce, combine all ingredients in small pan and cook until sauce is thick.
Enjoy.

name: Sushi Bake
ingredients: 3 cups cooked sushi rice or regular good quality white rice
1/2 cup /4 oz (110 g) softened cream cheese
1 tsp or more sriracha or hot sauce (optional)
ingredientNames: 3 cups cooked sushi rice or regular good quality white rice
1/2 cup /4 oz (110 g) softened cream cheese
1 tsp or more sriracha or hot sauce (optional)
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Microwave for few seconds to dissolve the sugar. Stir-in sesame oil. Set aside.
In a large bowl or 8 x 8 pan, add hot rice and pour vinegar mixture. Using a rice spoon, fold the rice until well coated. Set aide and cool completely.
Preheat oven to 450 F.
In a medium bowl. combine cream cheese, mayonnaise and hot sauce (optional). Add crab imitation, cucumber, mango, and green onion. Stir until well combined.
Take the rice in a pan and use the rice spoon to spread evenly and press against the pan.
Sprinkle with furikake then spread the crab mixture. Cover again with furikake.
Drizzle with Japanese mayonnaise and hot sauce or sriracha if desired.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until top just starts to brown.
Serve with a piece of nori sheet.
Enjoy!

name: Tamales / Bubuto
ingredients: 1/2 tsp annatto powder (achuete) or 3 tsp annatto seeds dissolved in 1/4 cup water
ingredientNames: 1/2 tsp annatto powder (achuete) or 3 tsp annatto seeds dissolved in 1/4 cup water
instructions: Heat cooking oil in a deep pan and saute garlic and onion.
Add coconut milk, ground pepper, salt and sugar. Boil in medium heat stirring constantly.
Add the rice flour and water. Cook and stir until well blended and thick.
Separate 3/4 of the cooked mixture. Set aside.
Combine 1/4 of the cooked mixture, peanut butter and the dissolved annatto powder. Cook for 5 minutes until well combined and thick. Remove from heat.
Place one layer of 8-10 inch banana leaf on a flat surface, and take a second leaf but turn it perpendicular so the leaves are crossing each other.
Place 4 tablespoons of cooked mixture; top with 3 tablespoon peanut-butter mixture, 2 slices of salted egg and 2-4 pieces of shrimps.
Wrap to form a square.
Grab extra banana leaves and rip a few strings off and tie the two ends together or use kitchen twine if available.
Secure the wrapped mixture with the banana strings.
Place all the bundles in a steamer.
Steam for 30 minutes.
Serve warm or cold.
Enjoy!

name: Tibok-Tibok
ingredients: 4 cups carabao's milk or fresh 100% milk)
3/4 cups or 1 cup sugar (adjust according to your preference)
coconut cream for latik or curd coconut cream topping
ingredientNames: 4 cups carabao's milk or fresh 100% milk)
3/4 cups or 1 cup sugar (adjust according to your preference)
coconut cream for latik or curd coconut cream topping
instructions: Prepare Latik by boiling coconut cream or kakang gata. This coconut cream will turn into solid and oil will separate. Get  a good brand of coconut cream if you will be using the one in can. Cook until color turns golden brown. Remove from oil and set aside.

In a pan (off the heat), combine milk, sugar and flour. Stir until smooth and no lumps. turn on heat and cook over low heat while stirring continuously. This will require an arm work out. Stirring will avoid the mixture to stick to the pan.
Cook the mixture until thick.
Prepare a round or square pan or any container you like and grease with oil from Latik. You can also line the pan with banana leaves and grease as well. Transfer the mixture and top with Latik.
Mixture is soft and perfectly goes well with the curd coconut topping.
Enjoy!

name: Tikoy
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together until well combined.
Grease 2 (6 inches) or 1 (9 inches) round pan with a non-stick cooking spray or brush with oil.
Transfer the mixture to a greased pan.
Steam for 1 hour on medium heat. Cover with cheese cloth to avoid water drips.
Remove from the steamer and let it cool.
Cover and seal with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate overnight or longer before cooking.

name: Ube Buchi
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 cups glutinous rice flour (adjust accordingly)
ingredientNames: 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 cups glutinous rice flour (adjust accordingly)
instructions: Prepare 1 cup of glutinous rice flour in a bowl. Set aside.
In a bowl, combine coating ingredients together. Set aside.
​In a small pot, combine water and sugar together. Simmer until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat then add to the prepared flour. Mix until smooth.
Add the remaining flour. Add more if needed depending on consistency. Please the video what it should look like.
Knead until a dough is formed.
Add vegetable oil. (This is optional. It just makes the dough easy to manage. Will not be a big deal if you add it or not). Knead until just combined.
Form into a log. Divide into 10 equal parts.
Flatten each dough with your fingers to make a round shape
Place about 1 tsp Ube filling on the center.
Gather all the sides and pinch together. Seal well.
Roll using the palm of your hands to make a nice round shape.
Dip the rice balls on coating mixture. Make sure all sides are covered.
Roll the coated rice balls in sesame seeds.
Heat oil in a deep pan.
Deep fry the sesame balls. Cook until
Remove from oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve warm.
Enjoy :)

name: Ube Butter Mochi
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, stir together eggs and milk. Whisk until eggs are fully beaten. Add butter, coconut milk, vanilla, and ube flavor. Stir until well combined.
In a large mixing bowl, add flour, sugar, and baking powder. Stir to combine.
Make a hole at the center of the dry ingredients and pour the wet ingredients. Stir until fully incorporated.
Line a 13x9 baking dish or pan with parchment paper or grease the pan generously with butter or oil.
Pour mixture in prepared pan.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350F for 1 hour or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for few minutes then slice to serve.
Best served when warm.

name: Ube Cassava Flan
ingredients: 2 cups cassava, grated ( I used frozen ready-made cassava in a pack but fresh can be used by grating and squeezing some juice)
7-1/2 tbsp sugar (2-1/2 tbsp for each llanera mold)
ingredientNames: 2 cups cassava, grated ( I used frozen ready-made cassava in a pack but fresh can be used by grating and squeezing some juice)
7-1/2 tbsp sugar (2-1/2 tbsp for each llanera mold)
instructions: Spoon 2 1/2 tbsp sugar in a flan mold or lyanera. (Prepare 3 molds). Caramelize over low heat until sugar turns to light golden brown. Using a thong, swirl the caramel evenly on the flat side of the mold. Remove from heat and cool completely.. (​If llanera is not available, you can use these oval pan or oval ramekins).
In a large bowl, add cassava, ube halaya or jam, coconut milk, condensed milk, egg and ube flavor. Stir until well combined.
Brush the sides of the mold with butter then pour the mixture. Divide evenly into three molds.

Heat water on a steamer over medium heat. Steam for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until set. Use a toothpick to test if it comes out clean.  (Make sure to cover the lid with a cloth to avoid water drip.) Remove from heat and cool completely.
To unmold, run a knife around the cassava flan. Place a plate on top of the mold and invert. Tap the bottom of the mold a few times to release the flan. Remove the mold.
The top will have some dark caramel. You can smooth by scraping with a knife or spatula but that's optional.
Slice and serve. Enjoy! ​​

name: Ube Kalamay
ingredients: 3/4 cup or 1 cup granulated sugar if you prefer it sweet.
1 cup purple yam, boiled and mashed
1 can, 15 or 19 oz coconut cream for Latik
ingredientNames: 3/4 cup or 1 cup granulated sugar if you prefer it sweet.
1 cup purple yam, boiled and mashed
1 can, 15 or 19 oz coconut cream for Latik
instructions: Prepare the latik by heating coconut milk or cream in a pan. Bring to a boil.  Lightly stir if bottom or sides of pan starts to brown. Milk will turn into solid and oil will separate. Cook until golden brown. Set aside.
Prepare a pan greased with oil from latik or line with banana leaves (heated to make pliable). Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and sugar.
Add coconut milk. Mix until fully incorporated.
Add purple yam and ube extract. Stir until combined.
Transfer to the prepared pan. (I used an 8" pan)
Steam over medium heat for 45 minutes. Notes: Make sure the water is already boiling. Cover the lid with cloth to avoid water drips.
Remove from steamer.
Top with latik.
Enjoy.

name: Ube Kutsinta
ingredients: Freshly grated coconut, dulce de leche, latik or caramel for topping
ingredientNames: Freshly grated coconut, dulce de leche, latik or caramel for topping
instructions: Water should be boiling.
Cover your lid with a kitchen towel to prevent water dripping into your mixture.
Your lid should cover your steamer tightly to prevent steam from escaping.
If your mixture is still watery in the middle after 30 minutes of steaming, it could be that your heat is too high or water is rapidly boiling. Adjust heat to medium-low.
Ideal size of mould is 2 1/4 inches or 3 inches #307 and #308.
You can also use silicone moulds, but make sure to also grease them.
Silicone moulds require less steaming time.
Ideal silicone mould size is 2 1/2 inches.
Optional topping includes grated coconut, budbod or toasted dessicated coconut,  latik or dulce de leche.
Please refer to my Corn Maja recipe on how to make budbod.
Dulce de Leche recipe.

name: Ube Palitaw sa Latik
instructions: Combine glutinous rice flour and water. Mix until it forms a dough.
Add ube flavor and stir until desired color is achieved.
Shape into balls and flatten to make a disc. Set aside.
Make latik by cooking coconut cream in a pan over low to medium heat.
Continue cooking until milk turns into solid and oil separates. Stir occasionally and cook until golden. Remove from pan and strain to remove excess oil.
Return the latik in the pan  Stir and bring to a boil  and until sugar is dissolved.
Drop pieces of palitaw discs and cook until discs starts to float.
Add pandan leaves and langka.  Bring back to a full boil about 2 minutes.
Transfer to a serving plate.
Enjoy!
Recipe yields 20-25 pieces ube palitaw.

name: Ube Tikoy Roll with Cheese
instructions: When tikoy is ready, slice into strips.
​Place a strip of tikoy onto a spring roll wrapper.
Add cheese strip on top of tikoy.
Wrap by gathering sides and roll until filling is fully covered.
Seal edges with water.
Deep fry until all sides are golden.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve and enjoy.

In a bowl, combine coating ingredients together. Set aside.
​In a small pot, combine water and sugar together. Simmer until sugar is dissolved. Remove from heat then add to the prepared flour. Mix until smooth.
Add the remaining flour. Add more if needed depending on consistency. Please the video what it should look like.
Knead until a dough is formed.

Roll the coated rice balls in sesame seeds.

Remove from oil and drain on paper towels.

name: Adobong Mani
ingredients: 1 head garlic cloves, skin removed and thinly sliced
2 cups cooking oil, I used vegetable oil
1/2 tsp to 3/4 tsp salt, adjust accordingly
ingredientNames: 1 head garlic cloves, skin removed and thinly sliced
2 cups cooking oil, I used vegetable oil
1/2 tsp to 3/4 tsp salt, adjust accordingly
instructions: Heat cooking oil.
Add garlic and fry until golden and crispy. Do not overcook. Remove from oil and set aside.
Lower the heat then add raw peanuts. Stir occasionally and cook until color turns copper brown, about 15 minutes. Do not overcook or they will taste bitter.
Remove from oil and transfer to a strainer or colander to drain excess oil.

Line a large tray with paper towels. Transfer the peanuts. Spread evenly and roll them (using a spatula or paper towels, to continue draining the excess oil. You want the peanuts to be dry and not oily. Cool completely by leaving on the tray for few minutes.
Once completely cooled, transfer to a large bowl. Season with salt and add the garlic chips. Stir until full salt is fully incorporated with the peanuts.
Serve and enjoy!
Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container.

name: Asado Siopao
ingredients: 1 lb pork belly, cubed or cut into strips
1 tbsp cornstarch diluted in 1/4 cup water
ingredientNames: 1 lb pork belly, cubed or cut into strips
1 tbsp cornstarch diluted in 1/4 cup water
instructions: If  the dough is ready, punch down to release some air packets. Transfer to a floured surface.​​
Divide dough into 4 equal parts and roll into a log. Divide log into four pieces, about 2-1/2 ounces each piece.
Use a rolling pin to form a round flat thin dough leaving a small bulge at the center.
Add a good amount of filling on the middle. Gather the four edges together, twist and pinch the top to fully wrap the filling.
Line bottom of each bun with 2-3-inch square pieces of parchment paper.
Place the filled bun on a tray with space in between and cover with a damp cloth or plastic food wrap. Rise for about 30 minutes.
Arrange the buns on a steamer pan allowing an inch space between buns  Cover the steamer lid with a clean cloth to avoid water drips.
Steam until done, about 15 to 20 minutes. Do not over-steam or they will dry out.
Serve warm with homemade Asado Sauce.
Enjoy.

ingredients: 2 cups or 16 ounces unsalted butter, room temperature cut into small pieces
ingredientNames: 2 cups or 16 ounces unsalted butter, room temperature cut into small pieces
instructions: In a medium saucepan add the 1 cup sugar and 1/3 cup water then place on medium-high heat until temperature reads 235-240 F.

While waiting to achieve your desired temperature for the sugar syrup, beat the egg whites until foamy. Add cream of tartar then slowly add in 1/3 cup of sugar and continue beating until soft peaks form.
When sugar syrup is ready, drizzle the sugar into the meringue immediately.
Continue beating until meringue is cool/tepid.
Add room temperature butter into running mixer one piece at a time.
Add vanilla .
Beat until butter is combined and mixture has reached a silky consistency.

name: Siopao Sauce
instructions: On a medium bowl, stir together cornstarch and water.
Add soy sauce and sugar. Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Using a medium sauce pan, turn on heat to medium-low.
When hot enough, add vinegar and cook for about 20 seconds.
Add the sauce. Bring the heat to low and bring the sauce to a light boil.
Add star anise. Stir constantly and cook until sauce is thick.
Serve with Siopao Asado.
Enjoy.

name: Baked Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 pound brussels sprouts, trimmed and sliced in half
6-8 slices of bacon, cut up - I used turkey bacon for a healthier version
ingredientNames: 1 pound brussels sprouts, trimmed and sliced in half
6-8 slices of bacon, cut up - I used turkey bacon for a healthier version
instructions: Mix with all ingredients and place on a roasting pan.
Roast at 400 degrees for about 20-25 minutes, until browned but not charred.
Enjoy!​​

name: Baked Mussels
ingredients: 15-20 pieces mussels on half shells, rinsed and cleaned
1/2 cup or more grated cheddar  cheese for topping
ingredientNames: 15-20 pieces mussels on half shells, rinsed and cleaned
1/2 cup or more grated cheddar  cheese for topping
instructions: I used frozen green mussels. To prepare, defrost the mussels by running it under cold tap water for  approximately 2-3 minutes and set aside.

Some recipes precook the mussels, while others don’t. The only advantage of precooking is that the mussels open up on their own. If you decide not to precook, it will be a little hard to handle to prize them open with a knife.

If using fresh mussels, scrub the mussels, removing any dirt and hairy bit, clean and discard any that are broken. Put the mussels in a pot with the water, cover and put on a medium-high heat for a couple minutes until they open up. Remove from the heat and remove one side of the shell.​
If oven is not available, these mussels can be grilled as well.
If the mussels were precooked, bake for only about 10-12 minutes.

name: ​Baked Tahong
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees F.
Combine butter and garlic.
Arrange mussels in tray covered with foil.
Spread with butter & garlic mix.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Enjoy!
